snippet.title: PHANTOM CHAINS Trailer
snippet.description:
Phantom Chains is a first person action dungeon crawler with an emphasis on exploration and mystery in a dark fantasy world

Wishlist PHANTOM CHAINS
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2339890/Phantom_Chains/

Classic RPG Combat: Inspired by the King's Field and Shadow Tower series, combat is deliberate and deep. Use bows, axes, swords, magic, and even the environment to conquer the challenges that face you.

An Atmospheric, Surreal World: A unique dark fantasy world full of variety and horror.
